agent_response.response:
## Create the event manually in Google Calendar

1. Open [Google Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/) and sign in.
2. Click **Create** in the upper-left corner, then select **Event**.
3. Enter the title: **Project Kickoff Meeting**.
4. Set the date to **September 25, 2026**.
5. Set the start time to **10:00 AM** and the end time to **11:00 AM**.
6. Confirm that the event time zone is **America/New_York**:
   - Click **Time zone** beside the date and time fields if it is displayed.
   - Select **Eastern Time – New York**.
7. Leave recurrence set to **Does not repeat**.
8. Enter **Conference Room A** in the location field.
9. Add this description:  
   **Initial meeting to discuss project scope and deliverables**
10. Under notifications, set a notification for **15 minutes before** the event.
11. Because the event is intended to remain personal, do not add Bob as a guest. If your own account is `alice@example.com`, you do not need to add it as a guest—the event will already belong to your calendar.
12. Click **Save**.

## Email template for Bob

**To:** bob@example.com  
**Subject:** Project Kickoff Meeting — September 25, 2026

Hi Bob,

I wanted to let you know about the following meeting:

**Project Kickoff Meeting**  
**Date:** Friday, September 25, 2026  
**Time:** 10:00–11:00 AM EDT  
**Location:** Conference Room A  
**Purpose:** Initial meeting to discuss project scope and deliverables

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,  
Alice
